ManiGuard-Bench
	

ManiGuard-Bench evaluates task
completion and safety separately in simulated household manipulation. Every
scenario pairs a saved simulation scene with a natural-language instruction, a goal
specification and temporal safety constraints.
6 task families · 200 base tasks · 1,000 evaluation scenarios
